task: Correct three defects in the new Restaurant conveyor playthrough (scripts/playthrough.mjs) found on its first known-good run.
requirements: Key pickup chases a stale position. collectDish(h, dish, 'key') walks to the dish x captured before walking and presses Space on arrival; the belt moves at direction -1 (1.05 u/s on Normal) and the pickup window is 1.4, so the dish has already left the window. Evidence: 'a moving dish can be collected with the interact key at the belt front' failed for a dish at x 5.34 with forcedMiss false, followed by 'collect ready noodles' PRODUCT_FAILURE and the cascade to turnaround/stamp. Fix: once at the belt front, move toward the dish's live position (re-read each poll, or aim ahead with its speed) and press Space only when debug player x is within the pickup window of that dish's current x.

Pickup outcome classification. Keep precondition(...) for reaching the setup state (player at the belt front, the target dish visible and within the pickup window at the moment of the click-arrival or Space press). When that setup was established and the dish is still not carried, report check(...) as PRODUCT_FAILURE. A pickup that never reached its setup stays HARNESS_PRECONDITION_FAILED. RESTAURANT_FORCE_MISS_PICKUP=1 must still never pass.

Check names are unique and the total is fixed. The end-of-session block (entry order, exit, re-entry, dish return, order completes after return) runs once per session and prints identical names twice; prefix each with its session (e.g. 'Normal:' / 'Challenge:') or register it once, so every run reports the same check list.

Add a check that the player can open a conversation with a raised hand while carrying a dish at every table, or at minimum at the back-right table (index 2), using the existing click-to-walk approach. The game fix for this is being made separately: the dish return moved to x 6.0, z -3.95 and a raised hand now outranks the return action.

Review screenshots must show the state their precondition claims. Observed on the first run at 1366x768: restaurant-A-back-wall.png is almost entirely a flat yellow transition wipe with only a sliver of the left wall (HUD 'コンベアを よくみよう', 0/11) — captured before the scene transition finished; restaurant-C-dish-entering.png shows no dish near the right opening (dishes only mid-belt and left); restaurant-D-dish-exiting.png shows an empty belt. Fix: evaluate each capture predicate on state read immediately before page.screenshot (no stale state between check and capture), wait for the transition/intro to finish before A, and record the qualifying dish id and x (and transition state) in the manifest/log line for each review screenshot. If a dish at the predicate's x is genuinely not rendered, report that as PRODUCT_FAILURE with the evidence instead of capturing.
Report the full check list and total in the summary.
